column1: # Stage S10 H2e, a page crate: the field tools (the mortar calculator with its inputs, solution
# cards, map picker, saved fire missions and offline status) become
# crates/frontend/pages/field_tools_pages. The area folder becomes the crate's `src`, its module
# tree `lib.rs`, and its README the source tree README; the calculator's feature docs move to the
# crate's documentation mirror. The prefix is one `crate::` row scoped to the moved folder and one
# `field_tools_pages::` row scoped to the app's source.
